objective: Pre-registered iteration-3 plan: (S1) RE-ABLRC whole-sample symmetric (2H-1)x(2W-1) [resp. 3D] DCT-I-class embedding + boundary-banded Woodbury correction to cut the free-vs-torus modeling gap by >= 50% (median, 2D+3D pooled) at median reported residual bound <= 1e-6 with w <= min(H,W)/8, and (S2) SSAM-CAM (spectral-spatial alternating minimization with circulant-accelerated Anderson mixing) to solve the masked system (P_m K P_m^T + lambda I) w = y_m at >= 3x median wall-clock speedup vs standard PCG at equivalent KKT residual < 1e-6 with RMSE parity, plus a 4-domain x 6-method benchmark (dense KRR subsample<=4000, PCG, KISS-GP, RFF, RE-ABLRC+SSAM-CAM, optional HSS), O(N log N)/O(N) scaling to N ~ 1e5, ablations, and boundary-controlled GRF tooling (scripts/grf_boundary.py). Envelope: CPU-only, 12 cores, 7 GB, <= 90 min total (A1<=25, A2<=30, A3<=20, A4<=5, A5<=5, A6<=5); results written to results/iter3/*.json. Source of truth for execution: ideas/proposal-final.json + results/iter2 canonical artifacts (T1b-CG-masked-train.json rate means 245.1/276.1/280.9 iters at tol 1e-8, per-field span 233-291, final relative residual per-field 4.69e-9..9.81e-9, RMSE means 0.529-0.541; EXECUTION_NOTES pre-fix figures 420-550 iters / RMSE 0.78-0.83 are SUPERSEDED and never cited).

A1_boundary.name: A1 boundary (free-boundary gap reduction)
A1_boundary.task: synthetic free-boundary GRF solve (K + lambda I) alpha = y on controlled-free-boundary fields; methods compared on the SAME kernel and interpolation/evaluation protocol

methods.dense_free_ref: dense free-boundary reference: exact Cholesky solve of the free BTTB Gram at 64x64 and 24^3 ONLY; at 128x128 the reference is a PCG solve of the free-boundary BTTB system at tol 1e-8 (dense-equivalent), same residual convention as T1b, with iterations + final relative residual reported
methods.bccb_wrap: standard BCCB torus wrapping (periodized-distance Gram, spectral solve) - the baseline whose gap is being reduced
methods.re_ablrc: RE-ABLRC: whole-sample symmetric (2H-1)x(2W-1) [3D: (2H-1)(2W-1)(2D-1)] first-column embedding (DCT-I class, Martucci entry 45; NOT half-sample 2H reflective padding), exact circulant spectral solve, Woodbury correction confined to the edge band of width w = ceil(2.5*rho) (rho = kernel range in grid units; single 2.5 factor), rank r_2d = O(w(H+W)); 3D correction restricted to edge bands with r_3d = w(HW+HD+WD); 3D solve runs capped at 24^3 (at w=3: r_3d = 5184, r^2 ~ 26.9e6 doubles ~ 215 MB < 7 GB); 48^3 arm uses embedding-only + PCG cross-check (pre-registered cap), never 3D Woodbury
methods.dct_dst_comp: DCT/DST symmetric-convolution comparator (Martucci entry 45) applied to the same free-boundary solve: strongest boundary-aware classical baseline against which S1 must capture >= 50% of the gap reduction

w_sweep.fail_fast_rule: if the relative residual does not decay monotonically across the w-sweep, the arm fail-fasts on that configuration (guards the naive embed-solve plateau: measured ~0.18 relative at 32x32 matern32 ell=4, independent of padding)
w_sweep.claimable_guard: S1 win claimed ONLY for w <= min(H,W)/8 (w = ceil(2.5*rho); as rho approaches the grid dimension, w ~ O(H) drives the correction rank ~ O(N), silently exiting the O(N log N) + low-rank regime)
w_sweep.interior_vs_band: report relative interior-vs-band residual norm across the w-sweep; if the correction rank needed for median residual <= 1e-6 exceeds the w(H+W) budget, RE-ABLRC is reported NOT validated (hypothesis-gate G1 item 2)

A1_boundary.metric: median relative free-boundary gap reduction g = ||f_approx - f_free|| / ||f_free||, % reduction vs the BCCB-wrapping gap, pooled across 2D (64x64, 128x128) and 3D (24^3) and kernels/seeds
A1_boundary.win: median gap reduction >= 50% (2D+3D pooled) AND median reported residual bound <= 1e-6 AND w <= min(H,W)/8 (else NOT-validated if the rank budget is exceeded, REFUTED if the DCT/DST 50%-capture consequence fails)

A2_masked.name: A2 masked (SSAM-CAM vs PCG on the shared masked-Gram system)
A2_masked.shared_system: (P_m K P_m^T + lambda I) w = y_m - the SAME masked-Gram system the standard PCG reference solves (results/iter2/T1b convention); coefficients restricted to observed-cell support a = P_m^T w; spelled identically in S2 and here (F2 Res 3 / E item 2)

tasks.synthetic: synthetic 2D GRF, grids 64x64 and 128x128, random masks 10/30/50% + block masks, kernels matern32/matern52/rbf, seeds 0-19
tasks.kaplan: REAL Kaplan SST v2 36x72 fields via h5py 3.7.0 exactly as iteration-2 (results/raw/real: fields.npy 2005x36x72, sentinel |x|>1e30 cells missing, 53.4% missing), masks: polar caps, land, random 10/30/50%; future-blind split train 1856-01..2015-12 (idxs 0..1919) / test 2016-01..2022-12 (idxs 1920..2003); 2023-01 (idx 2004) EXCLUDED
tasks.fallback: pre-stated data-route fallback: if h5py is unavailable under the allowed stack, use the simulated-from-physics stand-in (as iteration-2 data_gen) with simulation_marker disclosure - NEVER silently

solvers.ssam_cam: SSAM-CAM: spectral step = FISTA-momentum gradient step on r_t = P_m(K a - y) with circulant BCCB preconditioner (floored spectrum) applied to the FREE-BOUNDARY operator (never torus wrapping in masked arms); spatial step = soft projection on observed cells (Lagrange-multiplier proximal update; hard-clamp = lambda->0 interpolant fixed point, explicitly avoided); Anderson mixing on the residual sequence, window m = 5 (fixed); step schedule eta_k = 0.5/(1 + k/200); iteration ceiling 500
solvers.pcg_ref: standard PCG on the masked Gram (P_m K P_m^T + lambda I), BTTB matvec + identity/floored-torus preconditioner (iter-2 T1b convention)
solvers.termination: KKT residual r_t := (P_m K P_m^T + lambda I) w - y_m relative to ||y_m||, IDENTICAL convention for both solvers (PCG final relative residual per-field 4.69e-9..9.81e-9 at tol 1e-8 in iteration-2; primary comparison at < 1e-6, matched secondary at 1e-8)

A2_masked.win: median wall-clock speedup vs PCG >= 3x pooled across synthetic + Kaplan (gate pools both; per-domain breakdown reported separately) at equivalent KKT residual < 1e-6 + RMSE parity on the SAME valid-cell evaluation domain as T1b (mask-excluded valid cells; A2 RMSE-parity judged on that domain per hypothesis-gate G1 item 5)
A2_masked.target_iterations: SSAM-CAM < 60-90 equivalent iterations (PCG needs 245-291 at tol 1e-8); per-iteration cost O(N log N + n), memory O(N); Anderson window m=5 rationale: contractive circulant-linear-part fixed-point map

A3_multidomain.name: A3 multidomain benchmark
domains: MNIST-784 infilling: kernel = RBF on pixel coordinates; grid KRR on 28x28 = stationary BCCB on flattened raster (per-image solves); held-out-digit classes + patch masks; NO post-hoc kernel/split selection (hypothesis-gate G1 item 4)
Kaplan SST v2 (real): future-blind train 1856-01..2015-12 / test 2016-01..2022-12; 2023-01 excluded
methods: kiss_gp (inducing regular grid + local bi/tri-linear interpolation; Toeplitz-BTTB inducing Gram solved via circulant machinery)
rff (sklearn Ridge on RFF features, iteration-2 B-arm convention)
hss_optional (Ambikasaran entry 54): attempted-if-budget; honest not-completed report if over-envelope
A3_multidomain.metrics: RMSE valid-only (mask-excluded cells), wall-clock, peak RSS, accuracy-per-flop, accuracy-per-byte (est_spectral_fit_flops / est_spectral_bytes conventions), iterations-to-tol, speedup-vs-PCG, boundary gap reduction %; per-domain + pooled medians
A3_multidomain.win: benchmark REFUTED iff KISS-GP wins >= 2 domains or dense KRR wins >= 1 domain in RMSE at equal-or-lower cost envelope; ties reported, no cherry-picked exclusions

A4_scaling.name: A4 scaling (O(N log N)/O(N) verification)
A4_scaling.task: embedding-only + PCG cross-check at N ~ 1e5: 2D 320x320, 3D 48^3 (embedding-only; NO 3D Woodbury); wall-clock/bytes/peak RSS vs est_spectral_fit_flops / est_spectral_bytes extrapolation curves as iteration-2 S-scaling

A5_ablation.name: A5 ablation (marginal contributions)
variants: RE-ABLRC without correction (pure whole-sample symmetric embedding solve)
SSAM-CAM on torus BCCB operator vs free-boundary operator (isolates the S1 marginal contribution in masked solves; hypothesis-gate G1 item 3 / E item 3)

A6_g8_tooling.name: A6 G8 tooling (boundary-controlled GRF generator)
A6_g8_tooling.deliverable: scripts/grf_boundary.py: boundary-controlled GRF generator with free / Dirichlet-zero / Neumann-zero / mixed boundary-value sets, Paciorek-Schervish non-stationary covariance (entry 57), seeds 0-19; full generator description published for reproducibility (corpus G8 REMAINS-OPEN scoped)

joint_S1xS2.name: joint S1xS2 claim arm
joint_S1xS2.budget_note: synthesis arm reusing A1 + A2 measurements only (no additional solves; the 90-min total is unchanged and per-arm caps sum exactly to 90)
claims: S1 boundary win (A1 outputs): median free-boundary gap reduction >= 50% pooled 2D+3D, residual bound <= 1e-6, w <= min(H,W)/8
S2 masked win (A2 outputs): median speedup >= 3x vs PCG at KKT residual < 1e-6 with RMSE parity
joint statement: RE-ABLRC (boundary) + SSAM-CAM (masked) together remove both iteration-2 bottlenecks without O(N^2)/O(N^3), per the win-rule label table

baselines.dense_krr: exact Cholesky solve of the dense Gram, subsample cap <= 4000 rows (CPU-only; O(N^2) memory / O(N^3) solve class that the proposal replaces); iteration-2 B-arm convention
baselines.pcg: standard PCG on the masked Gram (P_m K P_m^T + lam I) with BTTB matvec + identity/floored-torus preconditioner, relative-residual stopping (Templates entry 69), tol 1e-8 (iter-2 T1b convention: rate means 245.1/276.1/280.9, span 233-291, final rel residual 4.69e-9..9.81e-9)
baselines.kiss_gp: inducing regular grid + local (bi/tri)linear interpolation (Wilson & Nickisch 2015), Toeplitz-BTTB inducing Gram solved via circulant machinery
baselines.rff: sklearn Ridge on Random Fourier Features (Rahimi & Recht 2007), iteration-2 B-arm convention
baselines.hss_optional: HSS (Ambikasaran et al., review entry 54): optional sixth method, attempted-if-budget, honest not-completed report if over-envelope

data.synthetic_2d: free-boundary GRFs on 64x64 and 128x128, kernels matern32/matern52/rbf (ell=4.0 grid units, rho = kernel range), controlled boundary conditions (free/Dirichlet-zero/Neumann-zero/mixed per A6 generator), seeds 0-19; labeled synthetic with full generator description
data.synthetic_3d: 24^3 GRF blocks (3D analog of the 2D protocol; boundary-seeded, stationary within block, non-stationary variance per Paciorek-Schervish in A6), seeds 0-9; 48^3 embedding-only in A4
data.mnist784: MNIST-784 (28x28) infilling: kernel = RBF on pixel coordinates; grid KRR on flattened raster = stationary BCCB per-image solves; held-out-digit classes + patch-mask splits locked BEFORE runs; no post-hoc kernel/split selection
data.kaplan_real: REAL Kaplan SST v2 (results/raw/real: fields.npy 2005x36x72, index.npy, sst.mon.anom.nc; meta.json dataset.origin=real-kaplan-sst-v2); sentinel |x|>1e30 cells missing (53.4%); Nino3.4 box rows 17-18 / cols 38-47; ocean-only cells; masks polar caps / land / random 10/30/50%; future-blind train 1856-01..2015-12 (idxs 0..1919) / test 2016-01..2022-12 (idxs 1920..2003); 2023-01 EXCLUDED; read via h5py 3.7.0 exactly as iteration-2
data.kaplan_fallback: pre-stated fallback: simulated-from-physics SST-anomaly stand-in (generated as iteration-2 data_gen.py, Kaplan-like covariance, iid noise std 0.35) with simulation_marker disclosure in EVERY artifact - never silent substitution

cv_leakage_rules.future_blind_kaplan: train strictly 1856-01..2015-12 (idxs 0..1919), test 2016-01..2022-12 (idxs 1920..2003), 2023-01 (idx 2004) excluded from BOTH splits; valid-only denominators (masked cells excluded from training and from RMSE/coverage evaluation)
cv_leakage_rules.mask_regime: masks defined ONCE (seed 7 for Kaplan random-mask draws; fixed mirror construction as iteration-2); same mask schedule in CV folds and test; masked cells never in training nor in error/coverage denominators
cv_leakage_rules.mnist: held-out digit classes + held-out patch masks with NO overlap; both locked before fitting; no post-hoc selection
cv_leakage_rules.valid_cell_domain: A2 RMSE parity and all A3 RMSE judged on the SAME valid-cell evaluation domain as T1b (mask-excluded valid cells), so parity is interpretable
cv_leakage_rules.synthetic: train interior / test boundary band + masked cells (iteration-3 benchmark convention, review G7); seeds fixed 0-19 (2D) / 0-9 (3D)
cv_leakage_rules.reporting: per-domain breakdowns reported separately; pooled medians reported with per-field/per-seed detail; ties reported; no cherry-picked exclusions; EXECUTION_NOTES pre-fix T1b figures never cited (canonical iter2 artifacts only)

metrics.definition: RMSE on masked/held-out cells (reconstruction quality on missing cells)

metrics.definition: 0.90-coverage diagnostic per mask with explicit tolerance bands (global +-0.06, seam +-0.06, decay +-0.12), diagnostic only, never a guaranteed-calibration claim

win_rules.label_table: SINGLE pre-registration location (hypothesis-gate G2 item 8): S1 win iff median gap reduction >= 50% (2D+3D pooled) AND median reported residual bound <= 1e-6 AND w <= min(H,W)/8; else NOT-validated (rank budget exceeded) or REFUTED (DCT/DST capture consequence fails). S2 win iff median wall-clock speedup vs PCG >= 3x at equivalent KKT residual < 1e-6 (A2 pooled, RMSE parity); REFUTED iff < 1.5x. Benchmark REFUTED iff KISS-GP wins >= 2 domains or dense KRR wins >= 1 domain; ties reported, no cherry-picked exclusions. DCT/DST comparator: S1 must capture >= 50% of DCT/DST's own gap reduction else the boundary claim is reported NOT validated against the strongest classical boundary-aware baseline.
win_rules.s1: win iff median relative free-boundary gap reduction >= 50% (2D+3D pooled) AND median reported residual bound <= 1e-6 AND w <= min(H,W)/8; NOT-validated if the correction rank budget w(H+W) is exceeded for median residual <= 1e-6; REFUTED if the DCT/DST 50%-capture consequence fails
win_rules.s2: win iff median wall-clock speedup vs standard PCG >= 3x at equivalent KKT residual < 1e-6 (A2 pooled across synthetic + Kaplan; per-domain breakdown separate) with RMSE parity on the T1b valid-cell domain; REFUTED iff median speedup < 1.5x (honest negative reported)
win_rules.benchmark: REFUTED iff KISS-GP wins >= 2 of 4 domains or dense KRR wins >= 1 of 4 domains in RMSE at equal-or-lower cost envelope; ties reported; no cherry-picked exclusions
win_rules.dct_dst: S1 must capture >= 50% of the DCT/DST symmetric-convolution comparator's own gap reduction, else the boundary claim is NOT validated against the strongest classical boundary-aware baseline

kernel_lambda_schedule.rho_note: rho = kernel range in grid units; w = ceil(2.5 * rho) (single 2.5 factor); w-sweep {1,2,3,4} checks monotonic residual decay (fail-fast guard against the ~0.18 naive embed-solve plateau)

lambda.A1: lam = 1e-3 fixed (same for dense reference, BCCB wrap, RE-ABLRC, DCT/DST comparator)
lambda.A3: lam fixed per task from pre-registered set {1e-4, 1e-3, 1e-2} chosen by within-train valid-cell validation BEFORE seeing test cells; recorded in artifact; no post-hoc selection

kernel_lambda_schedule.spectral_floor: torus/RBF spectra floored at 0 (PSD projection) before ridge is added, with n_negative_eigenvalues recorded per kernel (iteration-2 convention; Matern kernels PD on the grids used)

dense_reference.pcg_dense_equivalent_128x128: PCG solve of the free-boundary BTTB system at tol 1e-8 used as the dense-equivalent reference at 128x128 (Cholesky O(N^3) is out of envelope there); identical relative-residual convention to T1b; iterations + final relative residual reported alongside the gap numbers

budget.sum_note: per-arm caps sum exactly to 90; joint_S1xS2 arm carries 0 additional minutes (reuses A1+A2 measurements)
budget.measurement_note: measurements amortized as iteration-2 (median-of-3 after warm-up for wall-clock); results written to results/iter3/*.json
budget.resource_tail: at N ~ 1e5 (320x320, 48^3 embedding-only) peak RSS stays far below 7 GB per iteration-2 S-scaling extrapolation (0.04 GB single field at 0.25-deg equivalent); one field kept in memory at a time

seeds.note: Kaplan mask sampling and bootstrap use seed 7 (same as iteration-2 Kaplan runs); per-domain random-mask draws seeded from it; seeds recorded in every results/iter3 artifact

honest_framing.novelty_scoping: no claim that Woodbury / Anderson mixing / FISTA / DCT embedding are new: these are classical components (review entries 42-45, 46-51, 53-54); the claim is the grid-KRR-targeted INTEGRATION: whole-sample symmetric embedding + boundary-banded low-rank correction for free-boundary BCCB solves (G5), and spectral-spatial AM with circulant-accelerated Anderson mixing for masked grids (G6), positioned against the iteration-3 gap coverage G5-G8
honest_framing.artifact_traceability: every number in the paper traces to results/iter3/*.json; no [simulated]-framing for real fields (dataset.origin=real-kaplan-sst-v2); synthetic GRF domains labeled synthetic with full generator description and seeds
honest_framing.t1b_citation_lock: T1b cited ONLY from results/iter2/T1b-CG-masked-train.json (rate means 245.1/276.1/280.9 iters at tol 1e-8; per-field span 233-291; final rel residual per-field 4.69e-9..9.81e-9; RMSE means 0.529-0.541); EXECUTION_NOTES pre-fix values (420-550 iters / RMSE 0.78-0.83) SUPERSEDED, never cited
honest_framing.acronym_unification: RE-ABLRC everywhere (no RE-ABLRC/RE-ABRLC variants); glossary line: corpus G5 'RE (Reflective Embedding)' = whole-sample symmetric (2H-1)x(2W-1)  [resp. 3D] DCT-I-class extension (Martucci entry 45), NOT half-sample 2H reflective padding
honest_framing.fallback_disclosure: Kaplan fallback (simulated-from-physics stand-in) carries simulation_marker in EVERY artifact if h5py is unavailable; never silent
honest_framing.no_sota_claims: no SOTA-ENSO-skill claim; no exactness claim beyond the stated classes (torus spectral solve exact for the embedded-torus kernel; free-boundary solves to reported residual tolerance)
honest_framing.ties_and_negatives: ties reported; failing arms reported honestly (NOT-validated / REFUTED labels from the win-rule table); no cherry-picked exclusions
